summary: TopBuild filed an 8-K disclosing its election to redeem all $400M of its 3.625% Senior Notes due 2029 on July 1, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest, contingent on stockholder approval for its pending acquisition by QXO under an April 18, 2026 merger agreement. The redemption is conditional on the Approval Condition, linking the debt retirement to deal completion. This secures the target's balance sheet ahead of a take-private, though no price per share or premium is stated. Watch for shareholder vote on the QXO merger and risk-arb spread.
